chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abī Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: How long does the woman in postnatal bleeding remain seated until she prays? He said: “Eighteen, seventeen; then she performs ghusl, uses a cloth, and prays.”

key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.تَحْتَشِي: she uses a cloth or padding to contain the bleeding
key_terms.تَقْعُدُ: refrains from ritual acts such as salat during the waiting period

ai.seo_question: How long does a woman in nifās wait before performing ghusl and resuming salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the waiting period for a woman experiencing nifās before resuming salat. It states a duration of seventeen or eighteen days, after which she performs ghusl, takes protective measures, and resumes prayer.
